title: Initial velocity calculation
description: Essential: Correctly applies energy conservation between hole S and point O to derive v_s = sqrt(v_0^2 - (4eEd)/m).

title: Magnetic field range derivation
description: Essential: Correctly determines the range for B_0 as 0 ≤ B_0 ≤ (m v_0)/(3e L).

title: Thrust force magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the z-component of thrust force as (3/5)n m v_0, with correct sign/direction.

title: Circular motion analysis
description: Important: Applies Lorentz force law to relate magnetic field, velocity, and trajectory radius in the cube.

title: Geometric exit condition
description: Important: Uses geometry of the cube (side L) and circular trajectory to find critical exit conditions.

title: Momentum transfer reasoning
description: Important: Applies momentum/impulse principle or Newton's third law to relate ion flux to thrust force.

title: Time-scale assumption use
description: Optional: Mentions or uses the assumption that transit time ≪ magnetic field period T.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign for thrust direction (should be negative z) or misinterprets force on thruster vs. on ions.

title: Magnetic field misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Treats B_x and B_y as constant or misapplies their periodic nature in the force calculation.
